cases.name: customer_with_loans
cases.selector_sql:
SELECT customer_id
                FROM public.loans
                GROUP BY customer_id
                ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, customer_id
                LIMIT 1
cases.expected_sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
    'customer_id', c.id,
    'loans', COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(
                json_build_object(
                    'id', l.id,
                    'loan_number', l.loan_number,
                    'amount', l.amount::text,
                    'status', l.status,
                    'start_date', l.start_date::text
                )
                ORDER BY l.id
            )
            FROM public.loans l
            WHERE l.customer_id = c.id
        ),
        '[]'::json
    )
)
FROM public.customers c
WHERE c.id = %s

cases.name: customer_without_loans
cases.selector_sql:
SELECT c.id
                FROM public.customers c
                LEFT JOIN public.loans l ON l.customer_id = c.id
                GROUP BY c.id
                HAVING COUNT(l.id) = 0
                ORDER BY c.id
                LIMIT 1
cases.expected_sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
    'customer_id', c.id,
    'loans', COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT json_agg(

FROM public.customers c
